missUsefulnessProbes.rationale: The question and feedback teach renewed review after a material risk changes an approved migration. The lesson names impact/approvals and qualifies emergency governance but gives no explicit post-approval risk trigger or decision.

The question and feedback distinguish a combined peer-review/build/test/deploy workflow from DAST, pentesting and broad lifecycle processes. The lesson mentions tests and version review history, not that pipeline or those contrasts.

The question and feedback define the reversal document and contrast impact analysis, continuity and generic playbooks. The lesson lists backout steps and rollback criteria, useful context without defining that document, its execution or recovery verification.

The policy-specific stem and feedback distinguish management authorisation from hash, availability and alert evidence. The lesson names approvals and resulting configuration evidence without the required CAB record or those contrasting proofs.

separatelyScopedFollowups.detail: Per-keyword chips and generated source text inherit all four profile codes although dictionary meanings span 5.1,5.2,4.1,2.2. Separate meaning scope from container tags.

Change record checklist does not explicitly correct post-approval material risk, combined CI/CD gates, backout-plan naming or policy-required CAB authorisation evidence. Review targeted instruction before claiming remediation.
